name: aurum-eleven-video
description: Remotion compositions rendering the Aurum Eleven hero loop and the line-up film for the website.

scripts.render:posters: remotion still HeroDesktop out/a11-hero-desktop.jpg --frame=12 --image-format=jpeg && remotion still HeroMobile out/a11-hero-mobile.jpg --frame=12 --image-format=jpeg && remotion still LineUp out/a11-sklad-poster.jpg --frame=150 --image-format=jpeg
scripts.render: npm run render:hero-desktop && npm run render:hero-mobile && npm run render:lineup && npm run render:posters
